name: Combat Chems Stash
text: On activation roll a D6: a 1 sets Attacks to 1, a 2 adds 1, a 3 or 4 adds 2, a 5 or 6 adds 3. The result lasts to the end of the round and raises the Attacks characteristic, so it stacks with Paired weapons.

name: Gene-smithing
text: Optional recruitment rule: a new fighter may take an origin (Vatborn, Natborn or Unborn) and a few upgrades that change its profile and cost. The quick-start gangs use none, and it is not implemented in v1 (the upgrade table is not encoded).
